name: dsh-plugin-render-fix
description: 插件渲染修复：侧边栏「插件」页因旧版 WebView 缺少 URL.canParse 而渲染崩溃、内容区永久空白；本插件自动 polyfill，并提供恢复卡片与崩溃日志。 / Plugins render fix: repairs the sidebar Plugins page that crashes to a permanently blank content area because Android WebView 116 lacks URL.canParse, with a polyfill, a recovery card and a crash log.
